mapping.draft_py:
# Confiscate (FDN), an Aura for {4}{U}{U}.
# "Enchant permanent"                     compiled (B1-enchant-permanent: ENCHANT IS_PERMANENT), kept
# "You control enchanted permanent."
# M21 Enthralling Hold's verified B4-gain-control-enchanted ("You control enchanted creature."):
#   GAIN_CONTROL for YOU of what the Aura enchants, with no duration, on the Aura's spell carrier;
#   the engine anchors that one row to the Aura (verbs._v_gain_control: it ends when the Aura
#   leaves, and follows the Aura's controller), and G0's carrier lint admits exactly this effect
#   (lints._control_aura). "Enchanted permanent" is M21 Faith's Fetters' verified IS_ATTACHED_TO_
#   SOURCE alone ("Enchanted creature" adds TYPE_EQ 'Creature').
abilities = [
    SpellAbility(
        kind=SpellKind.ENCHANTMENT,
        effect=A(Verb.GAIN_CONTROL, {
            'controller': ControllerRef.YOU,
            'target': Selector(
                count=QUnbounded(),
                mode=SelectorMode.ALL,
                filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_ATTACHED_TO_SOURCE),
                zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
            ),
        }),
    ),
]

clauses.ir: abilities[0].effect (GAIN_CONTROL of the enchanted permanent, the Aura's carrier effect as M21 Enthralling Hold's)

mapping.notes: M21 Enthralling Hold's verified carrier form of 'You control enchanted creature.' (GAIN_CONTROL with no duration, anchored to the Aura by verbs._v_gain_control; the carrier lint admits it) over the enchanted permanent (M21 Faith's Fetters' IS_ATTACHED_TO_SOURCE). The G1 probe never shows a control change (its snapshot reads the world's zone controller, not the control overlay), so the packs carry it. Packs: tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/confiscate_takes_a_creature_while_attached.json, tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/confiscate_takes_a_noncreature_permanent.json, tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/confiscate_takes_a_noncreature_permanent_until_it_leaves.json.
